12-05.title: General election of 1890
12-05.text: The 1890 election brought the Liberals to power and is often seen as the start of party politics in New Zealand.

12-05.title: John Key announces his resignation
12-05.text: Prime Minister John Key unexpectedly announced he would step down after eight years, saying he had nothing left in the tank. Bill English succeeded him.

12-05.title: 54th Parliament opens
12-05.text: The new Parliament met and elected Gerry Brownlee as Speaker. Te Pāti Māori held protests around the country the same day.
